name: aarskog_syndrome
symptoms: Mildly sunken chest (pectus excavatum) ,  Testicles that have not come down (undescended) ,  Mild to moderate cognitive problems ,  Belly button that sticks out ,  Top portion of the ear folded over slightly ,  Bulge in the groin or scrotum ,  Small nose with nostrils tipped forward ,  Single crease in the palm of the hand ,  Wide-set eyes with droopy eyelids ,  Poorly developed middle section of the face ,  Wide groove above the upper lip, crease below the lower lip ,  Mild to moderate short height which may not be obvious until the child is 1 to 3 years old ,  Small, broad hands and feet with short fingers and curved-in fifth finger ,  Short fingers and toes with mild webbing ,  Delayed teeth ,  Scrotum surrounds the penis (shawl scrotum) ,  Hairline with a "widow's peak" ,  Delayed sexual maturity ,  Rounded face ,  Downward palpebral slant to eyes (palpebral slant is the direction of the slant from the inner to outer corner of the eye)
description: I've been noticing some unusual physical characteristics in myself, including a mildly sunken chest and undescended testicles. Additionally, I've been experiencing mild to moderate cognitive problems. I've also observed some distinct facial features, such as a belly button that sticks out, a top portion of the ear that's folded over slightly, and a small nose with nostrils tipped forward. My eyes are wide-set with droopy eyelids, and I have a poorly developed middle section of the face. I've also noticed a wide groove above my upper lip and a crease below my lower lip. Furthermore, my hands and feet are small and broad with short fingers and curved-in fifth fingers, and my toes are short with mild webbing. I've also had delayed teeth and a scrotum that surrounds my penis, giving it a "shawl scrotum" appearance. My hairline has a "widow's peak" shape, and I've experienced delayed sexual maturity. Overall, I have a rounded face with a downward palpebral slant to my eyes, and I'm slightly shorter than average, which wasn't noticeable until I was around 1 to 3 years old.

name: abnormal_uterine_bleeding
symptoms: Tenderness and dryness of the vagina ,  Heavier bleeding (such as passing large clots, needing to change protection during the night, soaking through a sanitary pad or tampon every hour for 2 to 3 hours in a row) ,  Mood swings ,  Periods that occur less than 28 days apart (more common) or more than 35 days apart ,  Bleeding or spotting from the vagina between periods ,  Excessive growth of body hair in a male pattern (hirsutism) ,  Hot flashes ,  Bleeding that lasts for more days than normal or for more than 7 days ,  Time between periods changes each month
description: I've been experiencing some concerning symptoms related to my menstrual cycle, including tenderness and dryness of the vagina, as well as heavier bleeding, which has led to me passing large clots, needing to change my protection during the night, and soaking through a sanitary pad or tampon every hour for 2 to 3 hours in a row. Along with these physical symptoms, I've also been experiencing mood swings. My periods have become irregular, occurring less than 28 days apart or more than 35 days apart, and I've noticed bleeding or spotting from the vagina between periods. Additionally, I've developed excessive growth of body hair in a male pattern, which is quite distressing. I've also been experiencing hot flashes, and my bleeding has been lasting for more days than normal, often exceeding 7 days. To make matters more complicated, the time between my periods has been changing each month, making it difficult for me to predict when my next period will be.

name: abo_incompatibility

description: I've been experiencing a feeling of impending doom, along with severe chest pain, and I've noticed that my skin and the whites of my eyes have taken on a yellowish hue, which I'm worried might be a sign of jaundice. I've also been having bronchospasms, which have led to coughing fits, and I'm concerned that I might be experiencing acute kidney failure, as I've noticed blood in my urine. Additionally, I've been feeling chills, and my blood pressure has been low, which has left me struggling to catch my breath and feeling dizzy. To make matters worse, I've been dealing with nausea and vomiting, and I've had a fever. I've also been told that I might have disseminated intravascular coagulation, or DIC. Furthermore, I've been experiencing pain at the infusion site, and my heart rate has been increasing, which has been causing me a lot of anxiety. Lastly, I've been having low back pain, which has been making it difficult for me to move around comfortably.
